domain: All typed planner inputs whose catalog is validated and whose world is a coherent fully published InventoryOnce world, matching the public planner contract. The complete planner and every private helper it transitively owns are checked against a frozen independent equation program; imported runtime semantics are final-source current authorities or the separately verified current FungibilityValue5 normalization equation. Reservation preservation composes the complete R134 current inspectInventoryReservationFeasibility equation, including recorded-deficit burden and sparse-record semantics, rather than treating bounded ReservationSafety B evidence as a universal value equation. No samples, native replay, graph replay, or stateful action credit are used.

equations.law: Plan one exact common-basis FIFO/FEFO allocation across every member revision, preserving exact member identities, package increments, expiry/increment diagnostics, and active reservation feasibility before returning source lines.
Accept depletion only without a destination and transfer only with a nonblank destination; reject every malformed reservation effect before allocation search.

Apply the complete hypothetical allocation to sparse projection overlays, including destination rows for transfer, then accept exactly when the certified reservation feasibility projection reports Feasible.
Provide a tombstone-aware sparse record overlay whose get/set/delete/has operations preserve immutable-base reads while retaining only local what-if mutations.
Insert one exact position identity into one sparse index bucket once and retain deterministic sorted order.
Remove exactly one position identity from one sparse index bucket and tombstone the bucket when it becomes empty.

Convert one exact eligible member source line into common pool units, derive its indivisible allocation increment, and retain the exact evidence needed to map allocator output back to physical identity.
Return the smallest legal common-basis quantum, requiring whole measured/serialized positions and package multiples while otherwise retaining the member reference quantum.
Return true exactly when any independent axis is required or currently nonzero.
Create one normalized stock selector for the exact member item/revision while preserving every common fungibility scope dimension.
Return exactly the projection positions selected by the certified stock-selector lookup.
Sum only positive primary-axis quantities from selected non-transfer positions in exact quantity arithmetic.
